routes.documentation: Pay someone. Body: { fromAccountId, method, payee, payeeName, payeeBank, payeeDisplay, amount, reference }

responses.label: 422 Invalid amount
422 Not enough money
422 Over daily limit

responses.body:
{{setVar 'uid' (replace (replace (header 'Authorization') 'Bearer vale-' '') 'demo-7f3a9c2e' 'demo')}}{{setVar 'amt' (bodyRaw 'amount' 0)}}{{setVar 'pid' (concat 'pay_' (faker 'string.numeric' 6))}}{{setVar 'today' (now 'yyyy-MM-dd')}}{{setVar 'cat' (body 'reference')}}{{#unless @cat}}{{setVar 'cat' 'Payment'}}{{/unless}}{{#if (eq (body 'fromAccountId') 'acc_sav')}}{{setVar 'idx' '1'}}{{else}}{{setVar 'idx' '0'}}{{/if}}{{setData 'dec' 'accounts' (concat @uid '.' @idx '.balance') @amt}}{{#if (eq (dataRaw 'dailyspend' (concat @uid '.date')) (now 'yyyy-MM-dd'))}}{{setData 'inc' 'dailyspend' (concat @uid '.total') @amt}}{{else}}{{setData 'set' 'dailyspend' @uid (object date=(now 'yyyy-MM-dd') total=@amt)}}{{/if}}{{setData 'set' 'accounts' (concat @uid '.0.balance') (divide (round (multiply (dataRaw 'accounts' (concat @uid '.0.balance')) 100)) 100)}}{{setData 'set' 'accounts' (concat @uid '.1.balance') (divide (round (multiply (dataRaw 'accounts' (concat @uid '.1.balance')) 100)) 100)}}{{setData 'push' 'transactions' @uid (object id=@pid title=(bodyRaw 'payeeName') category=@cat date=@today amount=(subtract 0 @amt) icon='transfer')}}{{#unless (find (dataRaw 'recents' @uid) (object key=(body 'payee')))}}{{setData 'push' 'recents' @uid (object key=(bodyRaw 'payee') method=(bodyRaw 'method') name=(bodyRaw 'payeeName') bank=(bodyRaw 'payeeBank') display=(bodyRaw 'payeeDisplay') lastPaid=@today)}}{{/unless}}{
  "id": "{{@pid}}",
  "status": "completed",
  "fromAccountId": "{{body 'fromAccountId'}}",
  "payeeName": "{{body 'payeeName'}}",
  "amount": {{@amt}},
  "reference": "{{body 'reference' ''}}",
  "date": "{{@today}}"
}
responses.label: 201 Payment sent
401 Session expired

responses.body:
{{setVar 'uid' (concat 'usr_' (faker 'string.numeric' 4))}}{{setVar 'created' (now 'yyyy-MM-dd')}}{{setVar 'fn' (substr (bodyRaw 'fullName') 0 (indexOf (bodyRaw 'fullName') ' '))}}{{setData 'push' 'signups' '' (object id=@uid firstName=@fn fullName=(bodyRaw 'fullName') email=(lowercase (body 'email')) phone=(bodyRaw 'phone') createdAt=@created)}}{{setData 'push' 'credentials' '' (object userId=@uid email=(lowercase (body 'email')) password=(bodyRaw 'password'))}}{{setVar 'chk' (faker 'string.numeric' 4)}}{{setData 'set' 'accounts' @uid (array (object id='acc_chk' name='Everyday checking' type='checking' last4=@chk currency='USD' balance=1000 status='active') (object id='acc_sav' name='Savings' type='savings' last4=(faker 'string.numeric' 4) currency='USD' balance=500 status='active'))}}{{setData 'set' 'cards' @uid (array (object id='card_001' holderName=(uppercase (bodyRaw 'fullName')) last4=@chk kind='debit' status='active' linkedAccountId='acc_chk' limits=(object dailySpend=1000 atmWithdrawal=300)))}}{{setData 'set' 'transactions' @uid (array (object id='txn_welcome' title='Welcome to Vale' category='Opening deposit' date=@created amount=1500 icon='salary'))}}{{setData 'set' 'recents' @uid (array)}}{{setData 'set' 'favourites' @uid (array)}}{{setData 'set' 'insights' @uid (object month=(now 'MMMM yyyy') periodLabel='This month' total=0 changePercent=0 weeks=(array) categories=(array) income=1500 netCashFlow=1500)}}{
  "id": "{{@uid}}",
  "fullName": "{{body 'fullName'}}",
  "email": "{{lowercase (body 'email')}}",
  "createdAt": "{{@created}}",
  "message": "Account created. You can now sign in."
}

data.name: recents
data.documentation: People each user has paid, oldest first. POST /payments adds new people. GET /payees/recent returns newest first.

data.name: favourites
data.documentation: Quick pay list per user. Removed entries are kept with removed: true and hidden by GET /quickpay.

data.name: dailyspend
data.documentation: Each user's spending today: { usr_x: { date, total } }. Resets when the date changes. Checked against the card's daily limit.

data.name: credentials
data.documentation: Login details of people who signed up. MOCK ONLY: a real server stores a password hash, never the password. No route returns this bucket.

data.name: signups
data.documentation: People who signed up. Added to by POST /auth/signup. Passwords are never saved.

data.name: transactions
data.documentation: Payment history per user, oldest first. Transfers and payments are added here.
